payload.description_html:
Fig 4. Bolcaichthys solanensis n. sp.
Lateral view of the holotype, MGP-PD 33556, in natural light (A) and coated in alcohol (B-D). Details of the cranium (C) and of the caudal fin (D). Scale bars 10 mm (A-B); 5 mm (C-D).
